chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū Ayyūb, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: How long does the postpartum woman remain seated until she performs salat (prayer)? He said: Eighteen, seventeen; then she performs ghusl, uses a cloth, and performs salat (prayer).

key_terms.النُّفَسَاءُ: a woman in the state of postpartum bleeding
key_terms.تَحْتَشِي: she uses a cloth or padding to contain bleeding

ai.seo_question: How many days does a postpartum woman wait before resuming salat (prayer) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal ruling concerning the maximum duration of nifas for a postpartum woman before resuming salat (prayer). It indicates that after this period, she should perform ghusl, take precautionary measures against bleeding, and then perform salat (prayer).
